tasks.label: build dev
tasks.detail: Stop the add-in in Fusion first -- Fusion holds the dylib open while it runs.

tasks.label: check artifact
tasks.command: lipo -info dist/FuseNest/FuseNest.dylib && codesign -dv dist/FuseNest/FuseNest.dylib && nm -gU dist/FuseNest/FuseNest.dylib | grep -E ' _run$| _stop$' && ls -la dist/FuseNest

tasks.label: package zip
tasks.detail: Universal build, then zip dist/FuseNest for sideloading.
